Complete incoming IronGolem.hurt snapshots Crackiness before super.hurt, emits extra IRON_GOLEM_DAMAGE only when parent bool true AND computed category changes. Crackiness sorts threshold fractions ascending (.25,.5,.75,1) and uses strict<: f<.25 HIGH, .25<=f<.5 MEDIUM, .5<=f<.75 LOW, f>=.75 NONE for normal finite nonnegative fractions. At exactly.25/.5/.75 it selects MEDIUM/LOW/NONE. It reads currentHP/currentmax, so max-attribute changes can alter bands without the same HP change. Four thresholds are one presentation policy, not four implementations.

Repair recalculates crack category through changed health on later render; it does NOT invoke incoming hurt, so no extra damage crack sound is requested by repair. Repair sound is qualified by any health change, even within same category. State is computed, not a separately persisted crack flag.
